description: ESP32-P4 (RISC-V, dual core, hardware FPU; no radio)
idf_defines_note: Baseline's console is the chip's native USB-Serial-JTAG port (Arduino HWCDC Serial).
versions_note: What release Baselines are built with (CI pins the same). flick builds with other installed versions too, but warns.
cflags_note: Hardware single-precision FPU: ilp32f, the same float ABI as Baseline (Arduino builds with rv32imafc_zicsr_zifencei_xesploop_xespv; the Espressif extensions only matter to hand-written assembly). -mno-relax and no small data: the gp register belongs to Baseline.
ldflags_note: Code and rodata share one address window on this chip, so the sketch's one flash segment is RWX by design.
